symptoms: Severe: Pulse > 120 bpm, SpO2 < 90%, PCO2 > 42, PO2 < 60, PEFR < 50%.

management_steps.details: Hydrocortisone 200mg IV STAT. MgSO4 25-50mg/kg IV over 20 min. Continuous nebulization: Salbutamol/Fenoterol + Ipratropium Bromide. Consider NIV. RSI if failing (Ketamine 1mg/kg load, then infusion 0.15mg/kg/hr). In extremis: Adrenaline 0.3mg subcutaneously.
Hydrocortisone 200mg IV STAT + nebulized B2 agonist and Ipratropium Bromide.
Prednisone 0.5mg/kg STAT PO + MDI B2 agonist.

warnings: Monitor for hypercapnia (PCO2 > 42 mmHg) indicating tiring/impending respiratory failure.
